entretien.title: Servicing that keeps your warranty
entretien.text: Oil change, filters, a service by the manufacturer’s schedule: servicing done here keeps your car’s warranty, with parts of matching quality. We tell you what’s urgent and what can wait.

carrosserie.title: A scratch, a dent? Send a photo
carrosserie.text: A door ding in a car park, a bumper scraped on a post, a scratch along the wing: take one or two photos with your phone and we’ll tell you what can be done and how much, before you even come in.

confiance.title: A clear quote, parts explained
confiance.text: Before we touch your car, we explain the fault, the parts to replace and the price. If we find something else along the way, we call you first. And we’re happy to show you the old parts.

infos.title: Come to the garage
infos.accessText: On chaussée Jules Ferry, the road heading out towards Longueau, east of Amiens. Park in front of the garage while you drop the car off, or in the nearby streets. If the car stays for the day, we’ll tell you where to leave it.

items.a: For servicing or a repair, yes: call 03 22 50 36 36 or send a request online and we’ll offer you a slot. For a quick check or some advice, drop by during opening hours.
Monday to Friday, 8:30am to 12pm and 1:45pm to 6pm. Saturday hours are to be confirmed: please call before coming.
Yes. You get the price before any work, and nothing is done without your go-ahead. For bodywork, one or two photos are often enough for a first estimate.

items.q: How long will you keep my car?
items.a: An oil change or brake pads take one to two hours. A timing belt, a clutch or bodywork often take one or more days, depending on parts. We give you the time frame with the quote.
Card and cash, to be confirmed with the garage. You pay when you collect the car.

items.q: Where do I park when I arrive?
items.a: In front of the garage at 376 chaussée Jules Ferry, while you drop off the car and keys. If it stays several days, we’ll tell you where to leave it.

carrosserie.title: Car body repair in Amiens
carrosserie.intro: A scratched door, a dented bumper, a car park ding: send a photo and we’ll tell you what can be repaired and how much. Every make, on chaussée Jules Ferry.

list.title: Scratches
list.text: Surface scratch or down to the metal: touch-up, polishing or repaint depending on the depth.

list.title: Dents and impacts
list.text: Door, wing, bonnet: we straighten when we can, and replace when that makes more sense.

list.title: Bumpers
list.text: Cracked, pushed in or hanging off: repair, refitting or replacement.

list.title: Headlights and mirrors
list.text: Yellowed lenses restored, mirrors and covers replaced.

how.title: Send 1 to 3 photos
how.text: One shot of the whole car, then a close-up of the damage, in daylight if you can.

how.title: We call you back with a price
how.text: A first estimate, then the final quote once we see the car. Free, no commitment.

how.title: We agree on a date
how.text: We tell you how long the car will be off the road and let you know as soon as it’s ready.

carrosserie.related: Insurance: if an assessor needs to see the car, bring the accident report and your insurer’s details and we’ll arrange it with them. To be confirmed with the garage.

entretien.metaDescription: Oil change, scheduled servicing, filters, brakes, timing belt in Amiens. Manufacturer warranty kept, free quote. Garage Gamain, chaussée Jules Ferry.
entretien.title: Car servicing and oil change in Amiens
entretien.intro: Regular servicing means fewer breakdowns and a car that sells better. We follow your manufacturer’s schedule, for every make, and tell you honestly what can wait.

list.title: Oil change
list.text: The right oil for your engine, a new oil filter, all levels checked.

list.title: Scheduled service
list.text: By the manufacturer’s programme: your car’s warranty is kept.

list.title: Brakes and tyres
list.text: Wear checked at every visit, and we show you where things stand.

list.title: Timing belt
list.text: Belt and tensioners replaced on schedule, before they take the engine with them.

how.title: Follow the handbook
how.text: Usually every 15,000 to 30,000 km, or once a year. The interval is in the service book or on the dashboard.

how.title: Watch the warning lights
how.text: A spanner or oil can on the dashboard means the oil change is due: don’t drive for months like that.

how.title: Before long trips
how.text: Before the holidays or winter: tyres, brakes, battery, fluids. An hour at the garage for peace of mind.

entretien.related: Not sure where your car is up to? Give us the registration and mileage, and we’ll tell you what’s due.
